draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kashid! This beach sits wedged between two rocky hills in a semicircular arch, and it's also called the poor man's Goa.
draft.hungryLine: Beach stalls do omelettes and poha from 8 AM till dusk, and about 1 km toward Murud you'll find places serving sea fish.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The beach is the star, but Phansad Bird sanctuary, Korlai fort and the Datta Mandir at Revdanda are all in the area.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a deserted stretch of beach in the evening, it's quiet and safe to walk.
moodReplies.surprise-me: You can drive to Kashid on a ship, the Ro-Ro ferry carries cars from Ferry Wharf to Mandwa.

spots.name: Korlai fort
spots.detail: Short drive · A fort near Kashid on the Konkan coast

spots.name: Nagaon
spots.detail: Short drive · A clean 3 km beach near Alibag with water sports

tips.title: Cycle in the early morning.
tips.body: Rent a bicycle and ride the long road at dawn, with lush green on either side.

tips.title: Book the Ro-Ro ferry ahead.
tips.body: Reservations for the ferry to Mandwa are a must, especially on weekends.

story.title: Between two hills
story.body: Kashid lies on the North Konkan stretch between Mandwa and Murud-Janjira, 15 km from Murud and 135 km from Mumbai.

story.title: Poor man's Goa
story.body: Its long, empty beaches made Kashid a favourite escape from the hustle of Mumbai and Pune.

story.title: Ferries and water sports
story.body: Hotels and homestays line the highway by the beach, water sports run at peak hours, and the Ro-Ro ferry lets you drive in by sea.
